capabilities: display a scrollable row of tabs for open notes on mobile
switch notes by tapping a tab
auto-scroll the active tab into center view
show a save status dot when autosave-control is installed
extras: Warns that the save indicator dot may break if autosave-control changes its DOM class names; desktop is unaffected and customization is done via CSS snippet overrides.
problem: Obsidian mobile lacks a quick visual way to switch between multiple open notes.

relations.evidence: The save dot reads .save-status-icon from autosave-control's DOM

summary: Browser-style tab bar that replaces the mobile title bar with a scrollable row of tabs for switching between open notes.
